name: tigergraph
description: TigerGraph plugins for AI coding agents

plugins.name: tigergraph
plugins.description: Connect to any TigerGraph deployment — self-managed, on-premise, or a TigerGraph Savanna instance — using your host and credentials. Explore and evolve the graph schema, run GSQL and Cypher, load data from files and warehouses, and search vector embeddings.

plugins.name: tigergraph-skills
plugins.description: Skills that teach the agent how a TigerGraph cluster works and how to operate it from the command line with gadmin, gsql and the cluster scripts. No database connection needed.
